summary: XMax Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Xmax Beta Holdings Ltd., subscribed for an additional $5.45 million interest in Preamble X Capital I, raising its total interest to over 99.9%. Preamble X Capital I then used $5.35 million of that to acquire a 3.68% interest in a private investment fund, which will buy 258,051 shares of SpaceX Class A Common Stock. No board recommendation or advisor named. No premium, price per share, or close date given. This is a routine capital allocation to an investment vehicle, not a special situation.
